title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with Park Hee-ju (박희주)
description:
그리웠던 우리의 걸보스! 빅보스! 희주 피디님과 함께 했습니다💓
1주년에 함께하지 못해서 너무 아쉬웠지만, 그래도 댓글로 1주년 응원도 해주셨는데요!
지금은 티비에서 열일하고 계시지만 라디오에 언제든 놀러 오시면 언제든 환영이라구요!🤗

Long time no see, our big boss! We had 'Teatime Monday' with producer Heeju💓
It was a shame that we couldn't be together for the 1st anniversary, but she still cheered us in the comments!
She is working hard as a TV director right now, but she is always welcome to the radio as well!🤗
